description: This file is a JavaScript module for integrating Google Calendar event sources with FullCalendar, including class definitions, methods for fetching and processing calendar data, and error handling.

classes.name: GcalEventSource
classes.description: A class extending EventSource to handle Google Calendar API integration, including parsing input, fetching events, and error reporting.

methods.description: Parses raw input to create a GcalEventSource instance if applicable.

methods.description: Fetches calendar events from Google Calendar API within a date range.

methods.description: Converts Google Calendar API items to raw event definitions.

methods.description: Constructs the API URL for fetching events.

methods.description: Builds request parameters for the API call based on date range and timezone.
